serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
It should be around here, near the garbage. 
Oh, I see now what he meant. A group of homeless people decided to occupy this place. Tight spaces like this give good protection from the cold wind.
I found this place with no issue, but what now? I’m not going to strong-arm them into leaving, I’m just one normal person against a whole group. 
Should I bribe them?
No, if they see that I’m willing to give them money they will try to extort me every week.
